title: Polygamma recurrence: psi^{(n)}(z+1) = psi^{(n)}(z) + (-1)^n n! z^{-n-1}
expression_sketch: polygamma(n, z + 1) - polygamma(n, z) - (-1)**n * factorial(n) * z**(-n - 1)  ==  0
latent_structure: The n-th polygamma is the n-fold z-derivative of psi. Its unit shift is a repeated-node / Hermite divided difference of the simple-pole family, equal to the explicit monomial (-1)^n n!/z^{n+1}. Higher Matsubara kernels (order-n+1 poles) are this recurrence. Not CSE of two polygamma heads, and not the trigamma defining series 5.15.1.

function_domains.polygamma: psi^{(n)}(z) meromorphic for n=1,2,...; poles of order n+1 at z=0,-1,-2,... (DLMF 5.15 preamble and 5.2.2)

analytic_domains.label: DERIVED
analytic_domains.source: DLMF 5.2.2 / 5.15: polygamma poles at 0,-1,-2,...; 5.15.5 also needs z^{-n-1} finite

branch_conventions: z^{-n-1} is the principal power (n integer so single-valued off z=0); polygamma has poles, no branch cut

derived_conditions.statement: n! is finite and nonzero for n=1,2,...
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

why_not_cse_lgg: The rational monomial z^{-n-1} is not a shared subexpression of psi^{(n)}(z+1) and psi^{(n)}(z). CSE/LGG do not invent Hermite repeated nodes of the pole 1/z. Distinct from the n=1 series definition 5.15.1.
proposer_leak_risk: Source names polygamma and the shift. Do not leak 'Hermite DD', 'repeated node', 'higher Matsubara pole', or Hurwitz-zeta rewrite in proposer context.
notes: Fully SymPy-writable (polygamma, factorial). Not thermal-05 (5.15.1 series). Not thermal-03 (digamma reflection 5.5.4) and not the polygamma reflection 5.15.6. n starts at 1 on the cited preamble; n=0 is 5.5.2 (thermal-09), a different equation.
